entries.text: Hey, you’re one of those students from Paldea!\c\nSee, I happen to make chairs in my free time...
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnic_01

entries.text: but I’m a bit stuck on what design to use for\nsome nice picnic chairs.
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnic_02

entries.text: Could you maybe show me any tablecloths\nyou’ve got on you?
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnic_03

entries.text: Oh, maybe you aren’t all that interested in\npicnics...

entries.text: Hrrmm, I see! So these are the kinds of designs\npeople in Paldea like, huh?

entries.text: I’m going to try making some new chairs using the\ndesign you showed me!

entries.text: Phew! Since you came around I’ve been able to\nmake so many new chairs that I might just be\r\nfresh out of ideas!
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnic_18

entries.text: I think I’ll go ahead and enjoy a nice, relaxing\npicnic of my own. Thanks for your help!

entries.text: I’m just enjoying myself out here on my picnic.\c\nIt sure calms down the body and spirit even\nmore than usual when you love your picnic gear!

entries.text: Are you hungry? I can share with you, if you’d\nlike.
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_01

entries.text: Eating a nice sandwich outdoors in Kitakami\nreally is something special.
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_02

entries.text: How’re you feeling? You can take a rest, if you’d\nlike.
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_06

entries.text: Are you worn out from your adventures?\nYou’d better take a breather before you go!
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_03

entries.text: Three really does make company! Come by again\nwhenever you want!
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_04

entries.text: I’ll be here for a while, so feel free to stop by if\nyou get tired.
entries.label: s1_sub_013_picnicnpc_01_05

entries.text: Oho? Have you brought me yet another new\ntablecloth?

entries.text: Oho... Well, I’ll be! So this design is from a place\ncalled Blueberry Academy, is it?
entries.label: s2_sub_013_picnic_chair_02

entries.text: I’ll try making some new chairs based on this\ndesign!
entries.label: s2_sub_013_picnic_chair_03

entries.text: And a one, and a two... Here I go!
entries.label: s2_sub_013_picnic_chair_04

entries.text: The prototype is complete! I’ll give you these\nchairs as thanks for showing me that design.
entries.label: s2_sub_013_picnic_chair_05

entries.text: I was able to make so many new chairs thanks\nto you! I can’t express my appreciation enough!
